daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you permission to be a little messy today. Your vibe is unfiltered and magnetic—lean into it. This is your reminder that authenticity hits different than trying to fit a mold.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the energy shift in you. Whether you're single or coupled up, your confidence is doing the heavy lifting. Don't overthink a connection that feels natural; just let it breathe.
daily.career: Your intuition about a project or decision is sharper than usual. Trust that gut feeling even if you can't fully explain it yet. The momentum you build today sets up something interesting for next week.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentler movement today—maybe a walk, some stretching, or just time outside. Pay attention to what actually feels nourishing instead of what you think *should* feel good.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about expansion and authenticity. You're feeling called to step into spaces where you can truly be yourself. Trust the timing—something you've been waiting for is closer than you think.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, your vibe is magnetic rn. If you're in something, deeper conversations are flowing naturally. Single? Someone's definitely noticing your energy. Let things unfold organically.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different this week. Don't sleep on that project or pitch that's been sitting in your brain. You've got the momentum to make moves. Focus on what excites you, not just what pays the bills.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more intentional rest and play. It's not about grinding—balance is the vibe. Whether that's yoga, dancing, or just touching grass, tune into what makes you feel alive and energized.
